system.description:
• Effect: Vancian slot-based casting per the Spellblade Spells Per Day table below, from a narrower Spellblade spell list focused on self-buffs, melee-enhancing effects, and direct-damage spells rather than Wizard's full utility breadth.
  • DC = 10 + half your Spellblade level (minimum 1) + Intelligence modifier: see Spellcasting in Arneyan for the full formula.
  • Harmful or debuffing spells need a save, except Touch spells, which use a touch attack (see Spellcasting in Arneyan).
